slot_scores.name: idle_time_no_cost
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked whether idle machine or craftsman time incurs a cost, and did not explicitly mark this as an assumption needing confirmation.

slot_scores.name: fractional_batches_allowed
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Must the weekly quantities of products X and Y be whole batches, or may fractional batches be produced?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether fractional batches are allowed, matching the hidden slot's semantic hit rule.

slot_scores.name: all_batches_sold
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any upper limits on the weekly demand for products X or Y?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about demand limits, which is semantically equivalent to asking whether all produced batches are sold or whether demand constraints exist.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Idle machine and craftsman time incurs no cost.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about idle-time costs, but its READY_TO_MODEL summary and profit calculation implicitly assume unused capacity is free.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent resolved the P2 hidden slots it asked about and stopped after producing a final model; the only unresolved slot is P2, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent asked clear questions about fractional batches and demand limits, but silently assumed idle time has no cost. Since all unresolved issues are P2, the stopping behavior is appropriate.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
